caption: The video captures a static night cityscape centered on the segmented Taipei 101 tower, glowing teal with a bright blue crown. To its right, a slimmer skyscraper wears magenta lighting, while a blocky building at left shows a red-lit upper edge. Dense foreground towers with scattered window lights remain fixed beneath a thick, backlit cloud layer crossing the upper half of the frame. As the clip progresses, drifting fog eventually slides in front of the central tower's top, softening its blue spire into a hazy glow. For much of the excerpt the crown is hidden, then cloud thins and the illuminated tip becomes visible again. Small red obstruction lights blink intermittently on the right-hand skyscraper, while the colored facade lighting and skyline positions stay constant throughout.
relations: Drifting fog sliding across the upper frame intermittently occludes the teal tower's blue crown, softening it into a hazy glow.
When the cloud layer thins over the central tower, the illuminated blue tip re-emerges clearly from the haze.
Small red obstruction lights on the right magenta skyscraper blink intermittently while its facade lighting stays constant.
The colored facade lighting and skyline positions of all towers remain fixed beneath the moving cloud layer.
